name: a2a-mailbox
description: Cross-CLI agent mailbox: send and receive mail between Claude Code, Codex, Pi and ZCode agents (tmux injection / native queues / ssh federation). Mounts the mailbox MCP server from a WSL-side repo clone and ships the mailbox-watch skill.

description_i18n.en: Cross-CLI agent mailbox: mount the mailbox MCP server and the mailbox-watch skill, joining Claude Code / Codex / Pi / ZCode agents into one file-based federation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 跨 CLI agent 信箱：挂载 mailbox MCP 六工具与信箱守望技能，把 Claude Code / Codex / Pi / ZCode 接入同一文件信箱联邦。

args: for d in "$HOME/a2a-mailbox" "$HOME/workspace/a2a-mailbox"; do if [ -f "$d/mcp/mailbox_mcp.py" ]; then cd "$d" && exec python3 mcp/mailbox_mcp.py; fi; done; echo 'a2a-mailbox not found: git clone https://github.com/RegretSSS/a2a-mailbox into ~/a2a-mailbox or ~/workspace/a2a-mailbox (WSL)' >&2; exit 1
